title: The Daily Marketing Signal
summary: The gaming market this cycle presents a tale of two extremes. On the negative side, crowdfunded MMO Ashes of Creation has become the top trending topic on US Google Trends (50K+ searches) following mass executive departures, layoff warnings, and Steam's investigation into refund requests—severely damaging player trust in the Early Access model. On the positive side, the Nintendo Switch 2 game lineup continues to build momentum, with major titles like Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream and Metaphor: ReFantazio confirmed for the new console as the industry fully enters the next-gen Nintendo promotional phase. The Japanese market shows unique cultural fusion characteristics: Setsubun festival drives mobile game limited-time event discussions, Street Fighter 6's SFL Grand Finals ignites the fighting game community, and VTuber Inugami Korone's return stream tops YouTube trending. Cross-regionally, US players focus more on industry scandals and hardware iterations, while Japanese players center on community culture and esports analysis—highlighting significant market differences between the two regions.

sections.title: Game Tracking

content.label: Game Overview
content.text: Ashes of Creation is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by Intrepid Studios, featuring dynamic world systems and a player-driven economy. Built on Unreal Engine with impressive visuals, its core selling points include the Node system, siege warfare, and open-world PvPvE gameplay. As a Kickstarter darling, the project once carried enormous expectations.

content.label: Marketing Activities
content.text: The game previously secured substantial funding through Kickstarter and maintained community engagement through development logs and Alpha testing. The Early Access version recently launched on Steam but immediately encountered a major crisis upon release.

content.label: Player Sentiment
content.text: Current player sentiment has deteriorated dramatically. Director Steven Sharif resigned due to ethical disagreements with the board, triggering mass executive departures and layoff warnings. Steam is investigating refund requests, and the community is flooding forums with accusations of a "rugpull" scam—trust has hit rock bottom. Reddit and Steam communities are overwhelmed with negative reviews.

content.label: Game Updates
content.text: The Street Fighter 6 SFL 2025 Season Grand Finals took place this week, with Team CR delivering standout performances. Match footage and post-game analysis videos from pro players like Tokido, Dogura, and Kazunoko dominated Japan's YouTube Gaming charts, with combined views reaching extremely high numbers.

content.label: Market Performance
content.text: Extremely high engagement in the Japanese market, with SFL Grand Finals content occupying multiple trending spots on YouTube Gaming. Team and player discussions continue to trend on Twitter, with fighting game community activity reaching a peak.

content.label: Player Sentiment
content.text: Players highly praise the quality of SFL events, with in-depth analysis videos from pro players attracting core audience attention. The fighting game community ecosystem remains healthy with strong viewing and discussion engagement.

content.label: Game Updates
content.text: Minecraft shows strong performance on YouTube Gaming in both the US and Japan. In the US, a TNT master training challenge video garnered 1.68 million views; in Japan, Dozle Corp's variety-style MC challenge video reached 280K views, with creative gameplay continuing to attract players.

content.label: Market Performance
content.text: As an evergreen title, Minecraft ranks among the top on the US YouTube Gaming charts with consistent performance in Japan as well. The game's UGC ecosystem and creator economy continue to thrive.

content.label: Player Sentiment
content.text: Players maintain high appreciation for the game's creative freedom and community content output, with youth-oriented content consistently generating high traffic.

content.label: Game Updates
content.text: Capcom released a live-action trailer for Resident Evil Requiem showcasing the ruins of Raccoon City. The company launched QR code viral marketing campaigns in New York and Hollywood. As the 30th anniversary commemorative title for the Resident Evil series, marketing efforts are in full force.

content.label: Market Performance
content.text: The live-action trailer received prominent coverage from major outlets like IGN, with viral marketing campaigns sparking social media discussions. Series fan expectations are extremely high, with market attention continuing to climb.

content.label: Player Sentiment
content.text: Players have high hopes for this 30th anniversary title, with the live-action trailer's production quality receiving praise. The community anticipates this entry will integrate the series' storylines and deliver a fresh experience.

sections.summary: No major new releases this cycle, but Ashes of Creation's Early Access version became the focal point due to negative events; among top games, Street Fighter 6 esports events generated extremely high engagement, while Nintendo classic IPs continue to attract nostalgic players.

sections.title: Key Insights
sections.summary: Three core insights this cycle: crowdfunded MMO trust crisis, significant US-Japan market differences, and Switch 2 ecosystem warm-up.
sections.subtitle: Cross-Platform Data Analysis and Market Trend Assessment

items.title: Cross-Platform Hot Game Identification
items.text: Through cross-validation of Google Trends, Twitter, YouTube, and media coverage, we identified the games and events with the highest cross-platform engagement this cycle.

details.title: Ashes of Creation Negative Event
details.text: This game not only topped US Google Trends (50K+ searches) but also made headlines on major outlets like IGN while triggering a massive refund wave on Steam. This is the most damaging cross-platform story of the cycle, severely undermining player trust in crowdfunding and Early Access models. The fallout may impact the entire crowdfunding ecosystem for MMOs.

details.title: Street Fighter 6 Esports Ecosystem
details.text: Dominated Japan's YouTube Gaming charts (multiple pro player analysis videos), trended on Twitter with SFL team-related topics, and received media coverage of the event. This demonstrates the game's extremely solid esports ecosystem and community engagement, with fighting games maintaining their dominant position in the Japanese market.

details.title: Pokemon IP Penetration
details.text: The new card expansion "Ascended Heroes" received media coverage, VTuber streams featured Pokemon content, and Pokemon mobile games were discussed in festival-related topics. The IP's multi-dimensional penetration across cards, games, and merchandise remains the strongest in the industry.

items.title: Regional Market Difference Analysis
items.text: The US and Japanese markets show significant differences in player focus, content consumption habits, and community culture.

details.title: US Market Characteristics
details.text: American players focus more on industry developments and hardware iterations. Google Trends was dominated by the Ashes of Creation scandal, while YouTube Gaming featured major esports events (CS2 IEM, COD CDL) as mainstream content. Players show high sensitivity to industry news and strong reactions to crowdfunding trust crises. Twitter trends were occupied by entertainment IPs like WWE, with pure gaming topics showing lower organic engagement.

details.title: Japan Market Characteristics
details.text: Japanese players' gaming discussions are deeply integrated into daily life. Setsubun festival drives mobile game limited-time event discussions, horse racing events directly impact Uma Musume engagement, and convenience store collaborations have become routine marketing. YouTube Gaming shows a strong "personality-driven gaming" characteristic, with VTubers (Inugami Korone) and veteran streamers (Kiyo) commanding half the landscape. The deep analysis culture in the fighting game community is uniquely Japanese.

details.title: Switch 2 Effect
details.text: Media reports confirm multiple games including Tomodachi Life, Metaphor: ReFantazio, Star Wars Outlaws, and Resident Evil for Switch 2, indicating the industry has fully entered the promotional preparation phase for Nintendo's next-gen console. Third-party AAA port confirmations validate expectations for the new hardware's enhanced capabilities.

items.title: Player Focus Points
items.text: Based on community discussions and search trends, we identified players' core concerns and sentiment tendencies.

details.title: Early Access Trust Crisis
details.text: The Ashes of Creation incident has driven player trust in Early Access and crowdfunding models to rock bottom. Community discussions heavily focus on topics like "how to avoid being strung along" and "can crowdfunded MMOs be trusted." This event may lead to stricter player scrutiny of future crowdfunded game projects, and Steam's refund policies may tighten as a result.

details.title: Nostalgia and Remaster Demand
details.text: High search volume for Fallout Remastered and the popularity of original Luigi's Mansion playthroughs on Japan's YouTube demonstrate strong player demand for HD remasters of classic games. As long as quality delivers, "reheated classics" remain a market necessity, with Bethesda and Nintendo's classic IP long-tail effects remaining significant.

details.title: IP Crossover Trends
details.text: Gaming's role as a cultural medium continues to strengthen. Resident Evil Requiem's live-action trailer and viral marketing, Pokemon card collecting fever, and routine convenience store-gaming collaborations all show gaming IPs breaking traditional boundaries and penetrating broader cultural consumption spaces.

sections.summary: This report cites authoritative gaming media coverage from IGN, PocketGamer, and others, as well as public data from Google Trends, Twitter, and YouTube Gaming.
